entries.en: The dental records mentioned an apiceotomy, but the date of the operation was missing.
entries.zh: 牙科记录中提到一次牙根尖切除术，但手术日期缺失了。

entries.en: The drawing showed an apiciform projection that was barely visible in the original photograph.
entries.zh: 图画显示了一个尖形突起，而它在原照片中几乎看不出来。

entries.en: The dentist reviewed the earlier images before discussing the suspected apicitis.
entries.zh: 牙医在讨论疑似根尖炎之前，查看了较早的影像。

entries.en: She kept the letter about her apicoectomy with the rest of her dental records.
entries.zh: 她把有关自己牙根尖切除术的信与其他牙科记录放在一起保存。

entries.en: The historian compared two accounts of apicolysis written several decades apart.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两篇相隔数十年写成的肺尖萎陷术记述。

entries.en: The lecturer placed Apicomplexa on a separate branch of the diagram.
entries.zh: 讲师把顶复亚门放在图中的一个独立分支上。

entries.meaningZh: 牙根尖造口器〔旧器械名〕
entries.en: The museum's apicostome had a damaged handle, unlike the instrument pictured in the catalogue.
entries.zh: 博物馆的牙根尖造口器手柄受损了，与目录所配图中的器械不同。

entries.en: The old case report described an apicotomy without identifying which tooth was involved.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告记述了一次牙根尖切除术，却没有说明涉及哪颗牙。

entries.en: The analyst compared the apicycline spectrum with the reference spectrum supplied by another laboratory.
entries.zh: 分析人员把阿哌环素的谱图与另一家实验室提供的参照谱图作了比较。

entries.en: The curator moved the Apidae specimens into a cabinet with clearer family labels.
entries.zh: 策展人把蜜蜂科标本移入了一个科名标签更清楚的陈列柜。

entries.en: The handwritten note mentioned an apiectomy, although the accompanying dental diagram had been lost.
entries.zh: 手写笔记中提到一次牙根尖切除术，不过随附的牙科图已遗失。

entries.en: The two plant extracts contained different amounts of apigenin.
entries.zh: 这两份植物提取物所含的芹黄素数量不同。

entries.en: The chemist distinguished apigetrin from the corresponding aglycone in the analysis.
entries.zh: 化学家在分析中把芹黄素葡糖苷与相应的苷元区分开来。

entries.en: The apiin measurements were excluded because the reference material had been incorrectly identified.
entries.zh: 由于参照材料被错误鉴定，芹菜苷的测量数据被排除了。

entries.meaningZh: 松果体机能缺失〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old discussion of apinealism relied on an anatomical description that the author could no longer locate.
entries.zh: 那篇关于松果体机能缺失的旧论述，依据了一份作者已无法找到的解剖描述。

entries.en: The old report called the surface apinoid, although the photograph showed several visible stains.
entries.zh: 旧报告称表面洁净，但照片显示上面有几处明显污渍。

entries.en: The revised analysis distinguished apiol from the other constituents of the parsley extract.
entries.zh: 修订后的分析把洋芹醚与欧芹提取物中的其他成分区分开来。

entries.en: The apiole peak was labelled clearly, but the neighbouring peak remained unidentified.
entries.zh: 芹菜脑的峰标注得很清楚，但相邻的峰仍未被鉴定。

entries.en: The archive contained an apiolin advertisement and a letter questioning the seller's claims.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着一则洋芹素广告，以及一封质疑销售者宣传的信。

entries.en: She compared the Apios specimen with an older illustration before correcting the herbarium label.
entries.zh: 她把土圞儿属标本与一幅较旧的插图作比较后，更正了植物标本馆的标签。

entries.en: The student confused apiose with a different sugar in the first version of the diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在第一版图示中，把芹菜糖与另一种糖混淆了。

entries.en: The review of apiotherapy separated patient testimonials from controlled evidence.
entries.zh: 那篇蜂毒疗法综述把患者的个人见证与有对照的证据区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 蜂恐怖；对蜂的强烈恐惧
entries.en: His apiphobia made a picnic beside the beehives unappealing to him.
entries.zh: 由于强烈害怕蜂，他不想在蜂箱旁野餐。

entries.en: The collection's Apistobranchidae specimens were accompanied by detailed drawings of their bristles.
entries.zh: 馆藏的伪鳃科标本附有刚毛的详细图画。

entries.en: The study distinguished the effects of whole apitoxin from those attributed to a single isolated component.
entries.zh: 那项研究把完整蜂毒的作用，与归因于某一种分离成分的作用区分开来。

entries.en: The historical account of apituitarism included an anatomical drawing but no hormone measurements.
entries.zh: 那份关于垂体机能缺失的历史记述附有一张解剖图，却没有激素测量数据。

entries.en: The botanist moved the Apium specimens away from a group of superficially similar plants.
entries.zh: 植物学家把芹属标本移开，不再与一组外观相似的植物放在一起。

entries.meaningZh: 无胎盘动物〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The nineteenth-century textbook discussed Aplacentalia in a chapter with several hand-drawn animal diagrams.
entries.zh: 那本十九世纪教科书在一个附有数幅动物手绘图的章节中讨论了无胎盘动物。

entries.en: The optics lecture distinguished aplanatism from correction of chromatic aberration.
entries.zh: 光学课把消球面差与色差校正区分开来。

entries.en: The drawing showed an aplanospore beside the motile stage discussed earlier.
entries.zh: 图画显示了一个不动孢子，旁边是先前讨论过的能动阶段。

entries.en: The old diagram labelled one region aplasmic but did not show the boundary clearly.
entries.zh: 那张旧图把一个区域标为无原生质区，却没有清楚显示边界。

entries.en: The authors compared aplasmomycin with a related compound rather than treating their names as interchangeable.
entries.zh: 作者们把阿泼拉司霉素与一种相关化合物作比较，而没有把二者名称当作可以互换的名称。

entries.en: The zoologist checked the Aplectana identification against the drawings preserved with the specimen.
entries.zh: 动物学家对照与标本一起保存的图画，核查了双刺蛲虫属的鉴定结果。

entries.en: The old account of aplesia described persistent hunger despite regular meals.
entries.zh: 那篇关于不饱症的旧记述，描述了虽有规律进餐却持续饥饿的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 人工皮肤〔组织工程皮肤替代品商品名〕
entries.en: The clinician checked the Apligraf product information before discussing the case at the meeting.
entries.zh: 临床医生在会议上讨论该病例之前，核查了这种人工皮肤的产品资料。

entries.en: The museum displayed the Aplodontia skull beside a photograph of the corresponding specimen.
entries.zh: 博物馆把单齿鼠属头骨与对应标本的照片并列展出。

entries.en: The catalogue placed the Aplodontiidae material in a separate mammal cabinet.
entries.zh: 目录把山河狸科材料归入一个独立的哺乳动物陈列柜。

entries.en: The collector compared the aplome with the mineral illustration in an old field guide.
entries.zh: 收藏者把粒榴石与一本旧野外指南中的矿物插图作了比较。

entries.en: The Aplysiidae specimens were photographed before the exhibition labels were replaced.
entries.zh: 更换展览标签之前，工作人员给海兔科标本拍了照。

entries.meaningZh: 天冬氨酰苯丙氨酸甲酯〔缩写〕
entries.en: The analyst checked the APME result against the original record because the copied table was incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于抄录的表格不完整，分析人员对照原始记录核查了天冬氨酰苯丙氨酸甲酯的检测结果。

entries.en: The diagram contrasted the apneumatic region of lung with the surrounding air-containing tissue.
entries.zh: 图示把肺内的无气区域与周围含气的组织作了对照。

entries.en: The historical report discussed apneumatosis without suggesting that the lungs were anatomically absent.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告讨论了先天肺膨胀不全，却没有表示解剖上没有肺。

entries.en: The anatomist distinguished apneumia from failure of an existing lung to expand.
entries.zh: 解剖学家把无肺畸形与已有肺未能膨胀的情况区分开来。

entries.en: The lecture compared the apneustic breathing pattern with the shorter inspirations shown in another tracing.
entries.zh: 课堂上，讲师把长吸呼吸模式与另一条记录曲线所显示的较短吸气作了比较。

entries.en: The chemist compared the apoatropine spectrum with that of the reference compound.
entries.zh: 化学家把阿朴阿托品的谱图与参照化合物的谱图作了比较。

entries.en: The historical report described the apoblema separately from the surrounding tissue.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告把流产物与周围组织分开描述。

entries.en: The diagram showed apocarboxylase apart from the nonprotein component needed for the complete enzyme.
entries.zh: 图示把羧酶蛋白与完整酶所需的非蛋白成分分开显示。

entries.meaningZh: 泻除的；排泄的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historian questioned an apocathartic claim that the advertisement offered without supporting observations.
entries.zh: 历史学家质疑了一项广告中的泻除作用宣称，因为广告没有提供支持性的观察记录。

entries.meaningZh: 截断的；截肢相关的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old account linked the apocoptic change to the earlier amputation, not to a new injury.
entries.zh: 那篇旧记述把截肢相关变化与较早的截肢联系起来，而不是与新的损伤联系起来。

entries.en: The old stock list grouped apocrustia separately from preparations advertised as laxatives.
entries.zh: 那份旧库存清单把收敛剂与宣传为泻药的制剂分开归类。

entries.en: The botanist compared the Apocynaceae flowers with the family description in the field guide.
entries.zh: 植物学家把夹竹桃科花朵与野外指南中的科特征描述作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 夹竹桃麻苦素；加拿大麻苦素
entries.en: The apocynamarin result remained provisional because the comparison spectrum was incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于对照谱图不完整，夹竹桃麻苦素的检测结果仍属暂定结果。

entries.meaningZh: 夹竹桃麻素；加拿大麻素
entries.en: The paper distinguished apocynin from the mixture in the original plant extract.
entries.zh: 论文把夹竹桃麻素与原始植物提取物中的混合物区分开来。

entries.en: The older zoological guide placed Apoda in a section separate from the limbed amphibians.
entries.zh: 那本较旧的动物学指南把无足目与有肢两栖动物分在不同的小节中。

entries.en: The study examined apodehydrogenase separately from the cofactor associated with the complete enzyme.
entries.zh: 那项研究把脱氢酶蛋白部分与完整酶所结合的辅因子分开研究。

entries.en: The biologist checked the Apodemus skull against the measurements recorded on its specimen card.
entries.zh: 生物学家对照标本卡上的测量数据，核查了姬鼠属头骨。

entries.en: The older bird catalogue listed Apodi under a classification that differed from the newer guide.
entries.zh: 那本较旧的鸟类目录列出了雨燕亚目，所用分类与较新的指南不同。

entries.en: The anatomical account distinguished apodia from loss of a foot after an injury.
entries.zh: 那份解剖学记述把先天无足畸形与受伤后失去足的情况区分开来。

entries.en: The field guide's Apodidae photographs were too small to show the details she wanted to compare.
entries.zh: 野外指南中的雨燕科照片太小，无法显示她想比较的细节。

entries.en: The lecturer moved the Apodiformes illustrations into the section on bird classification.
entries.zh: 讲师把雨燕目插图移入了鸟类分类部分。

entries.en: The old catalogue grouped several apods together despite differences in their other features.
entries.zh: 那份旧目录把几种无足动物归在一起，尽管它们的其他特征有所不同。

entries.en: The diagram labelled apoferment separately from the cofactor associated with the complete enzyme.
entries.zh: 图示把酶蛋白与完整酶所结合的辅因子分开标注。

entries.en: The researcher compared apoferritin with the iron-containing protein rather than confusing the two materials.
entries.zh: 研究人员把去铁铁蛋白与含铁蛋白作了比较，而没有将这两种材料混淆。

entries.en: The curator compared the Apogon specimen with the drawing attached to the original collection record.
entries.zh: 策展人把天竺鲷属标本与原采集记录所附图画作了比较。

entries.en: The Apogonidae photographs were arranged beside the other fish-family displays.
entries.zh: 天竺鲷科照片被摆放在其他鱼类科级展品旁边。

entries.en: The essay distinguished apolegamic selection from selection caused by colder conditions.
entries.zh: 文章把性选择与较冷环境引起的选择区分开来。

entries.en: The laboratory reported apolipoprotein measurements separately from the total amount of fat in the sample.
entries.zh: 实验室把阿朴脂蛋白的测量数据与样品中的脂肪总量分开报告。

entries.meaningZh: 阿波利纳里斯矿泉饮料
entries.en: He ordered Apollinaris with dinner and left the unopened bottle beside his glass.
entries.zh: 他晚餐时点了阿波利纳里斯矿泉饮料，把未开封的瓶子放在玻璃杯旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 具有古典美的；阿波罗式的
entries.en: The critic contrasted the sculpture's Apollinian balance with the restless movement of the painting.
entries.zh: 评论家把雕塑富有古典美的均衡感，与画作中躁动不安的动感作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 阿波罗尼亚〔利比亚古地名〕
entries.en: She looked for Apollonia on an old map of Libya.
entries.zh: 她在一幅利比亚旧地图上寻找阿波罗尼亚。

entries.en: The fictional Apollonius left a folded letter on the table before joining his companions.
entries.zh: 虚构人物阿波罗尼奥斯把一封折好的信留在桌上，随后与同伴们会合。

entries.en: The illustration showed Apollyon above a dark opening in the ground.
entries.zh: 插图把亚玻伦画在地面一个黑暗洞口的上方。

entries.en: The historian found an apolysin order among the pharmacy's correspondence with its supplier.
entries.zh: 历史学家在药房与供应商的往来信件中，发现了一份阿朴利辛订单。

entries.meaningZh: 阿波纳耳〔盐酸多虑平商品名义项〕
entries.en: The pharmacist checked the Aponal packaging because the copied medicine name was difficult to read.
entries.zh: 由于抄录的药名难以辨认，药剂师核查了阿波纳耳的包装。

entries.en: The surgeon reviewed the earlier aponeurectomy report before discussing the patient's new symptoms.
entries.zh: 外科医生在讨论患者的新症状之前，查看了较早的腱膜切除术报告。

entries.meaningZh: 腱膜缝合术；腱膜修补术
entries.en: The old operative record mentioned aponeurorrhaphy but did not identify the suture material.
entries.zh: 旧手术记录提到腱膜缝合术，却没有说明缝线材料。

entries.en: The anatomist traced the aponeuroses across the diagram before adding the muscle labels.
entries.zh: 解剖学家沿图示描出了腱膜，随后添加了肌肉标签。

entries.en: The historian questioned how the old author had reached the diagnosis of aponoia.
entries.zh: 历史学家质疑那位旧时作者是如何得出智力缺陷诊断的。

entries.meaningZh: 热带爬行蜱属〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The old Aponomma identification was compared with the specimen's original drawings.
entries.zh: 研究人员把热带爬行蜱属的旧鉴定结果与标本的原始图画作了比较。

entries.en: The student drew each petal separately to show the flower's apopetalous structure.
entries.zh: 学生把每片花瓣分别画出，以显示这朵花的花瓣离生结构。

entries.meaningZh: 防御力减退的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The proposed apophylactic effect concerned defensive capacity rather than the shape of the cells.
entries.zh: 所提出的防御力减退作用，涉及防御能力，而不是细胞的形状。

entries.en: The collector turned the apophyllite specimen toward the light before photographing its crystals.
entries.zh: 收藏者给晶体拍照之前，先把鱼眼石标本转向光线。

entries.en: The anatomy lecture compared the apophysary region with the smoother surface beside it.
entries.zh: 解剖课把骨突区域与其旁边较光滑的表面作了比较。

entries.en: The apophysial outline was clearer in the second image than in the first.
entries.zh: 骨突的轮廓在第二张影像中比在第一张中更清楚。

entries.en: The lecturer corrected the apophysiary label after checking the drawing against the specimen.
entries.zh: 讲师对照标本核查图画后，更正了骨突标签。

entries.en: Our letter from Apopka arrived after we had already changed the meeting date.
entries.zh: 阿波普卡寄来的信到达时，我们已经更改了会议日期。

entries.en: The researcher kept the apoprotein measurements separate from those for the complete protein complex.
entries.zh: 研究人员把脱辅基蛋白的测量数据与完整蛋白复合物的测量数据分开保存。

entries.meaningZh: 营养缺乏病〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical discussion of aporinosis included a description of the family's limited diet.
entries.zh: 那篇关于营养缺乏病的历史论述，描述了那家人的饮食受限情况。

entries.en: She moved the Aporocactus pot away from the shelf before taking a closer photograph.
entries.zh: 她先把鼠尾掌属植物的花盆从架子旁移开，再拍了一张更近的照片。

entries.en: The botanist compared the Aporosa leaves with those shown in an older herbarium drawing.
entries.zh: 植物学家把银柴属叶片与一张较旧植物标本图中的叶片作了比较。

entries.en: The chemist marked the aporphine structure separately from the structures of its substituted derivatives.
entries.zh: 化学家把阿朴啡的结构与其取代衍生物的结构分开标出。

entries.en: The old report described an apositic patient who repeatedly left meals untouched.
entries.zh: 旧报告描述了一位反复不动饭菜的厌食患者。

entries.en: The botanist compared apospory with the spore-producing life cycle shown on the next slide.
entries.zh: 植物学家把无孢子生殖与下一张幻灯片所示的产孢生命周期作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 少量衄血；滴状出血〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old account distinguished apostaxis from the heavier bleeding described in the next case.
entries.zh: 那篇旧记述把滴状出血与下一病例中描述的较大量出血区分开来。

entries.en: The historical report located the apostema beneath the swelling shown in the drawing.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告指出，脓肿位于图画所示的肿胀部位下方。

entries.en: The old diagram marked the apostematic area with a dotted boundary.
entries.zh: 那张旧图用虚线边界标出了脓肿区域。

entries.en: The historical description of aposthia concerned a congenital condition, not a previous operation.
entries.zh: 那份关于先天无包皮畸形的历史描述，涉及的是先天状况，而不是此前的手术。

entries.en: The analyst compared apoterramycin with the reference material rather than relying on the handwritten label alone.
entries.zh: 分析人员把阿朴土霉素与参照材料作了比较，而没有只凭手写标签作判断。

entries.en: We used the apothem, not the radius, to calculate the regular polygon's area.
entries.zh: 我们用的是边心距而不是半径，来计算正多边形的面积。

entries.en: The diagram placed apotransaminase apart from the cofactor needed by the complete enzyme.
entries.zh: 图示把转氨酶蛋白与完整酶所需的辅因子分开显示。

entries.meaningZh: 向下转的〔胚珠方位用语〕
entries.en: The botanist redrew the apotropous ovule so that the micropyle's position was clearer.
entries.zh: 植物学家重新画了向下转的胚珠，使珠孔的位置更清楚。

entries.en: The old inventory listed an apozem separately from the dried herbs kept in the same cupboard.
entries.zh: 旧清单把一份煎剂与同一橱柜中保存的干草药分开列出。

entries.en: The study distinguished apozymase from the nonprotein component required for the complete enzyme system.
entries.zh: 那项研究把发酵酶蛋白与完整酶系统所需的非蛋白成分区分开来。

entries.en: The appaloosa waited quietly while its rider searched for the missing glove.
entries.zh: 骑手寻找丢失的手套时，那匹阿帕卢萨马安静地等着。

entries.en: The old report described appendical changes without linking them to the patient's unrelated cough.
entries.zh: 旧报告描述了阑尾变化，却没有将其与患者无关的咳嗽联系起来。

entries.en: The appendiceal findings were discussed separately from the changes seen in the surrounding intestine.
entries.zh: 阑尾的检查所见与周围肠道中观察到的变化被分开讨论。

entries.en: The lecture distinguished appendicectasis from inflammation of the same structure.
entries.zh: 讲课时，讲师把阑尾扩张与同一结构的炎症区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 假性阑尾炎〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical paper questioned whether appendicism adequately explained the patient's recurring pain.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文质疑，假性阑尾炎是否足以解释患者反复出现的疼痛。

entries.en: The surgeon compared the appendicocele drawing with the original operative description.
entries.zh: 外科医生把阑尾疝图画与原始手术描述作了比较。

entries.en: The old review separated appendicolithiasis from cases in which no stone had been found.
entries.zh: 那篇旧综述把阑尾石病与没有发现结石的病例区分开来。

entries.en: The broad diagnosis of appendicopathia in the old record did not identify a particular lesion.
entries.zh: 旧记录中的阑尾病这一宽泛诊断，没有指出具体病变。

entries.en: The review discussed appendicopathy without assuming that every case involved inflammation.
entries.zh: 综述讨论了阑尾病，却没有假定每个病例都涉及炎症。

entries.en: The historical author distinguished appendicosis from the inflammatory condition discussed earlier.
entries.zh: 那位历史作者把非炎性阑尾病与先前讨论过的炎症性疾病区分开来。

entries.en: The case notes mentioned an appendicostomy, but the accompanying diagram had no date.
entries.zh: 病例笔记提到一次阑尾造口术，但随附图示没有日期。

entries.en: The lecturer checked the appendolithiasis label against the specimen drawing before answering the question.
entries.zh: 讲师先对照标本图核查阑尾石病标签，再回答问题。

entries.en: The museum kept the appendotome beside the catalogue that illustrated its original handle.
entries.zh: 博物馆把阑尾刀与配有其原始手柄插图的目录并列保存。

entries.en: We kept the postcards from Appenzell even after the travel diary was lost.
entries.zh: 即使旅行日记遗失了，我们仍保存着来自阿彭策尔的明信片。

entries.en: She chose Apperleen for the coat's collar because she liked its raised surface.
entries.zh: 她喜欢阿珀利恩起绒呢的起绒表面，因此选择用它做外套衣领。

entries.en: The philosopher distinguished appetition from the deliberate decision to act on a desire.
entries.zh: 哲学家把欲望与经过考虑后决定依欲望行事区分开来。

entries.en: The applanate specimen fitted beneath the glass, unlike the rounded one beside it.
entries.zh: 扁平的标本能够放在玻璃下面，而旁边那个圆鼓的标本不行。

entries.en: The old formula listed apple-oil separately from fruit juice and plant extracts.
entries.zh: 旧配方把苹果油与果汁、植物提取物分开列出。

entries.en: We discussed Appleseed after the screening rather than leaving the cinema immediately.
entries.zh: 放映结束后，我们讨论了《苹果核战记》，没有立即离开电影院。

entries.en: The microscope image showed an appressorium on the plant surface.
entries.zh: 显微图像显示植物表面上有一个附着胞。

entries.meaningZh: 邻接的；邻近的〔牙科用语〕
entries.en: The dentist compared the approximal surfaces of the two neighbouring teeth.
entries.zh: 牙医比较了相邻两颗牙的邻接面。

entries.en: The archive kept the old Apra pamphlet with the other Peruvian political documents.
entries.zh: 档案馆把那本旧阿普拉党小册子与其他秘鲁政治文献放在一起保存。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the Apresoline name against the original prescription because the copied record was unclear.
entries.zh: 由于抄录记录不清楚，药剂师对照原处方核查了阿普雷沙林的名称。

entries.en: The analyst compared the aprindine result with the reference material's certificate.
entries.zh: 分析人员把安搏律定的检测结果与参照材料的证书作了比较。

entries.en: Her essay compared Aprism with the arguments in an old Apra pamphlet.
entries.zh: 她的文章把阿普拉主义与一本旧阿普拉党小册子中的论点作了比较。

entries.en: The archive's aprobarbital packet retained its purchase date but had lost the supplier's address.
entries.zh: 档案中的阿普比妥药包还保留着购买日期，但供应商地址已经脱落。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the Aprocta specimen with the measurements in the original collection record.
entries.zh: 动物学家把无疣丝虫属标本与原始采集记录中的测量数据作了比较。

entries.en: The apron-conveyor stopped before the next load reached the inspection point.
entries.zh: 下一批货物到达检查点之前，裙式运输器停了下来。

entries.en: The old report compared apronalide with another preparation without establishing that their effects were identical.
entries.zh: 旧报告把烯丙异丙乙酰脲与另一种制剂作了比较，却没有确定二者作用相同。

entries.meaningZh: 达意不能；失说写能〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old account of aprophoria described difficulties in both speaking and writing.
entries.zh: 那篇关于达意不能的旧记述，描述了说话和书写两方面的困难。

entries.en: The researcher considered aprosody separately from the speaker's ability to recall individual words.
entries.zh: 研究人员把失语韵能与说话者回忆单个词的能力分开考虑。

entries.en: The historical atlas illustrated aprosopia without providing a full description of the other anatomical findings.
entries.zh: 那本历史图谱用图展示了先天无面畸形，却没有完整描述其他解剖所见。

entries.en: The historian found a sketch of an aprosopus in a nineteenth-century medical atlas.
entries.zh: 历史学家在一本十九世纪医学图谱中，发现了一幅无面畸胎的素描。

entries.en: The laboratory compared aprotinin measurements with the recorded activity of the target enzyme.
entries.zh: 实验室把抑肽酶的测量数据与记录的靶酶活性作了比较。

entries.en: The old report distinguished apselaphesia from an inability to move the same hand.
entries.zh: 旧报告把触觉缺失与同一只手无法活动的情况区分开来。

entries.en: The older classification placed Apsidospondyli in a section no longer arranged the same way in the newer atlas.
entries.zh: 较旧的分类把弓椎亚纲列入一个小节，而较新图谱已不再采用同样的编排。

entries.en: The historical account described a brief episode of apsychia followed by a return of awareness.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述描述了一次短暂的意识缺失，随后意识恢复了。

entries.en: The philosopher distinguished an apsychical process from the conscious experience discussed in the previous chapter.
entries.zh: 哲学家把非精神性过程与上一章讨论过的意识体验区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 思想缺失；思考不能〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historian could not determine what evidence had led to the old diagnosis of apsychosis.
entries.zh: 历史学家无法确定，那项旧的思考不能诊断依据了哪些证据。

entries.en: The two aptamers bound differently, so the researcher did not treat them as interchangeable reagents.
entries.zh: 这两种寡核苷酸适配子的结合表现不同，因此研究人员没有将它们视为可互换的试剂。

entries.en: The curator compared the Aptenodytes skull with the photograph on the specimen card.
entries.zh: 策展人把王企鹅属头骨与标本卡上的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The nineteenth-century catalogue placed these wingless specimens under Aptera.
entries.zh: 那份十九世纪目录把这些无翅标本归入了缺翅类。

entries.en: The old zoological plate contrasted an apterygial form with a winged one.
entries.zh: 那幅旧动物学图版把一种无翼形态与一种有翼形态作了对照。

entries.en: The museum's Apterygidae display included a drawing beside each preserved specimen.
entries.zh: 博物馆的无翼鸟科展区在每件保存标本旁都配有一幅图画。

entries.en: The older guide discussed Apterygiformes separately from the other flightless birds.
entries.zh: 那本较旧的指南把无翼鸟目与其他不会飞的鸟分开讨论。

entries.en: The student drew an apterygote beside a winged insect for comparison.
entries.zh: 学生画了一只无翅亚纲昆虫，旁边画了一只有翅昆虫作为比较。

entries.en: The geologist compared fossils from the Aptian with specimens from a younger layer.
entries.zh: 地质学家把阿普弟阶的化石与较新地层中的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The historical discussion of aptyalia separated reduced saliva from other causes of mouth discomfort.
entries.zh: 那篇关于唾液缺乏的历史论述，把唾液减少与口腔不适的其他原因区分开来。

entries.en: Her review discussed APUD without assuming that every labelled cell released the same hormone.
entries.zh: 她的综述讨论了胺前体摄取与脱羧，却没有假定每个被标记的细胞都释放同一种激素。

entries.en: The student compared two translations of Apuleius before choosing a passage for the essay.
entries.zh: 学生比较了阿普列乌斯作品的两个译本，再为文章选择一段文字。

entries.en: The museum placed the Apulian pottery beside a map showing its region of origin.
entries.zh: 博物馆把阿普利亚区的陶器与一幅标示其来源地区的地图并列展出。

entries.en: The old anatomical report distinguished apulmonism from collapse of an already formed lung.
entries.zh: 那份旧解剖报告把无肺畸形与已经形成的肺发生萎陷的情况区分开来。

entries.en: The map traced the Apure past the settlement marked in the traveller's notes.
entries.zh: 地图描出了阿普雷河流经旅行者笔记中所标聚落的路线。

entries.meaningZh: 美国公共福利协会〔缩写〕
entries.en: The archivist found an APWA letter in the folder on public welfare.
entries.zh: 档案员在公共福利资料夹中发现了一封美国公共福利协会的信。

entries.en: The old report described the lesion as apyetous but did not claim that it was painless.
entries.zh: 旧报告把病变描述为无脓的，却没有声称它不痛。

entries.en: The histologist compared the apyknomorphous nuclei with the denser examples in the next image.
entries.zh: 组织学家把非固缩状细胞核与下一张图像中较致密的例子作了比较。

entries.en: The lecture distinguished an apyogenous response from the pus-forming process shown earlier.
entries.zh: 讲课时，讲师把非化脓性反应与先前展示的化脓过程区分开来。
